name: Seeed XIAO ESP32C5
radio: the SoC's own radios: wifi24, wifi5, ble, ieee802154

flash.bootloader_instructions: Hold BOOT while plugging in USB; release after a second. The chip's USB-JTAG-serial port appears.
flash.note: CircuitPython's downloadable .bin is a merged image (bootloader, partition table and app at their own offsets inside it) and is written at 0x0 on every Espressif chip, as Adafruit's web flasher does; the C5's bootloader address of 0x2000 is already inside the image. 8 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM (Seeed's spec table): the same parts as the ESP32-C5-DevKitC-1-N8R8, whose build's partition table fits — confirmed on the bench 2026-11-24 (10.3.2 at 0x0 boots, reports espressif_esp32c5_devkitc_1_n8r8, 8.2 MB free). Antenna: a U.FL connector only (LNA_IN), no onboard antenna — fit the supplied antenna or nothing is on the air.

usb.when: ESP32-S3/C5 USB-JTAG-serial (download mode and, with CDC on boot, the running firmware)

led.note: one yellow user LED on GPIO27 (Seeed: USER_LED). Seeed's example drives the pin LOW for on, so active-low is the expectation; 'led on' ran on the bench 2026-11-24 (the pin is right), the blink direction was not noted and the firmware does not honour active_low yet

battery.sense: GPIO6 through a 1:2 divider (two 100 k), gated by GPIO26 (BAT_VOLT_PIN_EN must be high to read)
battery.divider_note: the network foxes do not read a battery yet and the gate pin is not driven, so roles.batt_sense stays null; a 3.7 V cell on the pads charges from USB. A USB pack must not have a low-current cut-off, or the board never wakes from deep sleep.

notes: 5 GHz Wi-Fi and an 802.15.4 radio beside the 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and BLE. 8 MB PSRAM: mem= in the megabytes on the bench (8.2 MB free, 2026-11-24). Reset is CHIP_EN (the R button), Boot is GPIO28 (the B button). The fox's own scan lists 5 GHz networks; a 5 GHz access point needs a CircuitPython newer than 10.3.2 (its start_ap takes channels 1-13), and foxlib falls back to channel 1 with a note until then.
Power: a fox sleeps between transmissions; a USB power bank with a low-current auto-off cuts power during the sleep and the fox never wakes. Use a pack without auto-off.
Serial: native USB — the console port disappears while the chip sleeps and returns when it wakes. 'serial port dropped' each cycle is expected.

circuitpython.note: CircuitPython has no XIAO ESP32C5 build (checked 2026-10-24 and 2026-11-23: only the DevKitC-1-N8R8 and a Waveshare display board); the ESP32-C5-DevKitC-1-N8R8 build is the same chip with the same 8 MB flash and 8 MB PSRAM and runs here, reporting espressif_esp32c5_devkitc_1_n8r8 (bench 2026-11-24). Pin names are the DevKit's IOxx: no D0..D10 in dir(board), the aliases above are the XIAO silkscreen. The build is the DevKit's, not shared with another board in the catalog.
